summary: Iteration 65 — Cache correctness (Phase 2), API v2 envelope (Phase 3), and mypy fixes (Phase 4) verified end-to-end. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass; frontend smoke of login/catalog/courses/leaderboard/learn-243 clean with 0 console errors.

verifications.auth_cache_login_admin_learner: both /api/auth/me return correct identity/roles right after login
verifications.auth_cache_no_bleed: admin token -> admin email, learner token -> learner email in same session
verifications.auth_cache_refresh_boundary: call, sleep 32s (past 30s TTL), call again -> 200, identity intact
verifications.catalog_publish_invalidation: created org-1 course, warmed catalog, published -> course visible immediately (not stale for 60s). Then unpublished -> disappears immediately. Cleaned up.
verifications.catalog_repeat_consistency: two consecutive /api/catalog calls return identical totals
verifications.admin_analytics_cached: /api/admin/analytics returns non-zero stats; second call identical
verifications.api_v2_courses_learner: returns >=4 published courses in envelope with meta.count matching
verifications.api_v2_enrollments: learner enrollments enveloped with progress + last_slide_index
verifications.api_v2_catalog: enveloped with meta.total, meta.page, meta.page_size, meta.categories
verifications.v1_regression_courses: /api/courses returns plain list (not enveloped) — shape unchanged
verifications.v1_regression_course_243: /api/courses/243 returns id=243 and 99 slides — shape unchanged
verifications.progress_not_cached: learner enroll + save-progress -> v2/enrollments reflects progress=100 immediately (progress never cached)
verifications.frontend_smoke: Learner login -> /courses (9 cards visible incl. Module 1 with 99 slides), /catalog (marketplace w/ 4 IFPI Main Academy courses), /leaderboard (rank #1, 1700 XP), /learn/243 (slide 5/99 rendered, 99-slide TOC). 0 console errors across all pages.

critical_code_review_comments: core/cache.py memory backend sweep is O(N) on every set past 5000 entries — acceptable for now, but note that the sweep holds the lock. For high-write endpoints this could stall briefly. Consider a background sweeper if cache size grows.

auth cache stores the entire CurrentUser Pydantic object via pickle. If CurrentUser gains fields (e.g. entitlements) they will silently persist for 30s across role changes unless invalidate_current_user_cache() is called on every mutation of those fields. Today only role-sync + deactivation invalidate — worth documenting the contract in a comment above CurrentUser.

routers/api_v2.py catalog wrapper calls into routers/catalog.catalog() as a plain function. That function itself uses the catalog: cache — so v2/catalog benefits from the same cache key. Good. But the v2 wrapper does NOT pass a `q`/`category`/`org` filter so callers cannot search via v2 yet. Consider exposing filters in the v2 signature for feature parity.

routers/gamification.py leaderboard cache key includes org+cohort; XP changes may take up to 15s to reflect on the leaderboard. Acceptable per spec but should be documented in the OpenAPI description.

Test debris: 5 TEST_iter65_prog_* courses could not be DELETE-d (409 conflict — presumably due to existing enrollments/certs). They remain visible in the UAT tenant /courses page. Not a bug in this iteration, but suggests DELETE /api/courses/{id} should either cascade-delete disposable/draft courses or provide an admin force-delete. Filed as a low-priority action.

services/enrollment_service.save_progress: when slide_index is clamped to (total-1) because total<expected, the response's last_slide_index reflects the clamped value while progress uses (idx+1)/total. That's intentional but could confuse UI if course had fewer slides than the learner expected (observed in test debug output: sent slide_index=1 on a 1-slide course -> last_slide_index=0, progress=100).
